settings.apps.token.result.notice.description: Notice that issued tokens are shown once.

settings.apps.token.result.expires.defaultMessage: The access token lasts {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. Refresh it with the refresh token, which replaces both.
settings.apps.token.result.expires.description: Explanation of the lifetime of the issued access token. {minutes} is the number of minutes.

settings.apps.token.access.description: Label of the issued access token.

settings.apps.token.refresh.description: Label of the issued refresh token.

settings.apps.token.granted_scope.description: The scopes of the issued tokens. {scope} is a list of scopes.

settings.apps.secret.title.description: Heading of the notice that shows the secret of an OAuth app once. {name} is the app's name.

settings.apps.secret.notice.defaultMessage: This is the only time the secret is shown. Copy it now and keep it safe; if you lose it, give the app a new one.
settings.apps.secret.notice.description: Notice that the secret of an OAuth app is shown once.

settings.apps.secret.public.defaultMessage: The app “{name}” has no secret. Its client ID is shown below.
settings.apps.secret.public.description: Notice after a public OAuth app was registered. {name} is the app's name.

settings.apps.secret.client_secret.description: Label of the secret of an OAuth app.

settings.apps.copy.description: Button that copies a value to the clipboard.

settings.apps.copy.label.description: Accessible name of a button that copies a value. {name} is the value's label.

settings.apps.copied.description: Toast after a value was copied.

settings.apps.copy_failed.defaultMessage: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
settings.apps.copy_failed.description: Toast when copying a value failed.

settings.apps.done.description: Button that closes the dialog that showed the issued tokens.
